reviews.title: Sophisticated Vanity Upgrade!

reviews.title: Beautiful Sconces
reviews.content:
These wall sconces are absolutely beautiful and look even better in person. They would be perfect for a bedroom — very stylish and modern, and they instantly elevate the space. The quality feels solid, and they arrived well packaged with everything included.

The only reason I’m returning them is my own mistake — I ordered the wired version when I actually needed wireless. That’s on me for not reading carefully. There’s nothing wrong with the product itself, and if you’re looking for wired sconces, these are a great option. I’ll definitely be reordering the wireless version instead!
reviews.contentZh: 这些壁灯真是太漂亮了，实物比照片还要好看。它们非常适合卧室——既时尚又现代，能瞬间提升空间格调。质量感觉很扎实，包装也很到位，所有配件都齐全。我退货的唯一原因是我自己的失误——我明明需要的是无线款，却订成了有线款。怪我没仔细看产品说明。产品本身没有任何问题，如果你正在寻找有线壁灯，这些绝对是不错的选择。我肯定会重新订购无线款的！

reviews.sourceSheet: 硬接线-可更换灯泡式-长条式-透明式-源数据
reviews.title: High-end look for the price
reviews.content:
I was pleasantly surprised by how nice these look in person, especially for the price. They add a lot of elegance to the room and instantly elevate the space.

The lighting is great, not harsh, and the overall design looks clean and high-end once installed. They don’t feel cheap and photograph really well, which is a bonus.

If you’re looking to upgrade a room without spending a fortune, these are a great option. Very happy with this purchase.
reviews.contentZh: 实物比图片好看多了，尤其是考虑到价格，真是惊喜。它们为房间增添了不少优雅气息，瞬间提升了空间格调。灯光柔和不刺眼，安装后整体设计简洁高端。它们质感很好，拍照效果也很棒，这真是个意外之喜。如果你想提升房间格调又不想花太多钱，这些灯绝对是理想之选。非常满意这次购物。
